---
name: curation-entry
description: Add a UI principle pattern or reference to Ventura Toolkit with problem context tradeoff and canonical source identified. Use when extending the repository's UI principles and patterns. Do not use when implementing a concrete product interface in another repository.
---

# Curation entry

- Read the existing toolkit structure before adding a pattern.
- State the interface problem the pattern addresses.
- Describe the tradeoff or misuse condition rather than presenting a universal rule.
- Link a canonical or high-quality reference when needed.
- Avoid duplicate patterns under alternate terminology.
- Keep framework-specific implementation details out unless the section explicitly targets that framework.
